overview: A wide-eyed mermaid princess utterly obsessed with the surface world. Her route is pure delight: indulge her curiosity, and the only real question is which world you will end up sharing.
tips: Her favourite gifts are an Ordinary Fork and a Pearl Comb; she also likes a Gilded Hand Mirror, Cute Plushie, Sparkling Gemstone, Honey Cakes, Scented Bath Salts and Glitter Nail Polish. Never give Fresh Fish.
Her favourite date is Dinner at the Tipsy Wyvern, which Have Tub, Will Travel also requires. She is at Saltbreeze Harbor in the morning and afternoon.
Her checks run Charm 1 to 4, and Romance Scenes II and III need Charm 2 and 3 to unlock. A Sea Change needs Charm 4.

endings.title: Between the Tides
endings.summary: The Sea King blesses Coralie so she can switch between tail and legs at will. You build a cliffside house with a sea-cave beneath, she gets a horse called Captain Four-Legs, and her father visits every Starfall, mostly for the bread. The both-worlds ending: land and sea, shared equally.
howTo: At the festival, when the Sea King lifts his trident, choose "Hold her hand and let him finish."
It is always available, and the only option if you haven't unlocked either variant.

endings.title: A Sea Change
endings.summary: Instead of Coralie coming up, you ask to go down. The Sea King gives you a silver-pink tail you have no idea how to use, and you become Royal Ambassador to the Surface for a court that decrees forks are for hair. The most transformative ending: you give up the land for her.
howTo: In Romance Scene III, choose "Kiss me first. Here, under the moon." and pass the Charm 4 check.
At the festival, choose "Your Majesty, wait. I don't want her to come up. I want to come down."

endings.title: Have Tub, Will Travel
endings.summary: Coralie tells her father she doesn't want legs: she likes her tail, she just wants to see everything. With a conch for emergencies, you push her wheeled copper bathtub across the kingdom while she writes A Mermaid's Guide to the Surface (Mostly Correct). The adventurous ending, with no transformation needed.
howTo: Take her on the Dinner at the Tipsy Wyvern date at least once.

Plus any one of: in Romance Scene I, "Gently explain what everything really is." (pass Charm 2); in Romance Scene II, "Sweep her into your arms and carry her."; or in Romance Scene II, "Dance with her, one last time..." (pass Charm 3).
At the festival, choose "Squeeze her hand. 'Tell him about the bathtub, Coralie.'"
